name: Succor
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 5, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

For every 5 caster levels you possess, succor prevents 1 negative level, 1 level drain, 1 point of ability damage, or 1 point of ability drain (to a maximum of 4 levels or points prevented at 20th caster level) to the creature touched.
